changes.user_summary: Resolves JS plugin imports correctly, avoiding CSS misresolution.
changes.dev_summary: customJsResolver now returns undefined for non-JS files so @plugin resolves to the JS entry.

changes.user_summary: Playground dependencies updated.
changes.dev_summary: Dependencies in playgrounds bumped.

changes.user_summary: Relative imports now resolve to the correct file.
changes.dev_summary: Resolver now uses importer path and aliasOnly logic for relative files.

changes.user_summary: @variant directives are now processed by the Vite plugin.
changes.dev_summary: Features.Variants added to feature bitmask in @tailwindcss/vite.

changes.user_summary: Dependencies bumped across packages.
changes.dev_summary: Dependencies updated in all packages.

changes.user_summary: Plugin now resolves tailwindcss correctly even without a from option.
changes.dev_summary: inputBasePath now falls back to base when result.opts.from is missing.

changes.user_summary: NAPI dependencies updated.
changes.dev_summary: NAPI related dependencies bumped.

changes.user_summary: CI workflows updated for NAPI-RS.
changes.dev_summary: CI workflows now use Node v18 images for NAPI-RS.

changes.user_summary: Whitespace in arbitrary values is preserved correctly.
changes.dev_summary: Canonicalization now keeps '_' and wraps expressions with parentheses for readability.

changes.user_summary: Unit normalization no longer applied to arbitrary values.
changes.dev_summary: Canonicalization skips unit normalization for arbitrary values.

changes.user_summary: Variants using &:has are now converted to has-[] syntax.
changes.dev_summary: Arbitrary selector &:has is converted to has-[] variant during canonicalization.

changes.user_summary: Upgrade tool no longer changes CSS properties inside style attributes.
changes.dev_summary: Upgrade codemod skips inline style properties.

changes.user_summary: Typos in docs and comments fixed.
changes.dev_summary: Minor typos corrected.

changes.user_summary: Multiple @utility definitions with same name but different value types now work.
changes.dev_summary: @utility handlers now try next handler on null, enabling multiple definitions.

changes.user_summary: TypeScript error TS2742 no longer occurs when importing Config type.
changes.dev_summary: Exported Config type now resolves correctly in TS.

changes.user_summary: You can now write compound and stacked @variant rules using comma and colon syntax.
changes.dev_summary: The @variant directive now accepts comma-separated variants and a colon syntax for stacking, simplifying variant usage.

changes.user_summary: Source map visualization tests now print input and output for easier debugging.
changes.dev_summary: Added source map visualization utilities for tests, printing source locations and highlighted symbols.

changes.user_summary: Integration tests in CI are more stable.
changes.dev_summary: Adjusted integration test utilities to improve CI stability.

changes.user_summary: Codebase quality improved with better test practices.
changes.dev_summary: Updated tests to use correct variants, @reference, Vitest mocks, and modern assertions.

changes.user_summary: Enhanced-resolve dependency updated to 5.21.0.
changes.dev_summary: Bumped enhanced-resolve to 5.21.0, adding promise API and new options.

changes.user_summary: CSS for start and end utilities is no longer generated when no value is provided.
changes.dev_summary: Removed generation of CSS for start and end utilities without values.

changes.user_summary: Functional @utility definitions now require --value(…) to avoid accidental empty utilities.
changes.dev_summary: Enforced presence of --value(…) in functional @utility definitions.

changes.user_summary: You can now use --default(…) inside --value(…) or --modifier(…) for fallback values.
changes.dev_summary: Added --default(…) support in functional utilities, allowing defaults for missing values or modifiers.

changes.user_summary: New utilities for scrollbar-width and scrollbar-color are available.
changes.dev_summary: Introduced scrollbar-auto, scrollbar-thin, scrollbar-none, scrollbar-thumb-<color>, and scrollbar-track-<color> utilities.

changes.user_summary: Math operators in arbitrary values are now surrounded by whitespace for valid CSS.
changes.dev_summary: Ensured whitespace around operators in calc expressions during canonicalization.

changes.user_summary: Snapshot tests improved for clarity and stability.
changes.dev_summary: Replaced inline snapshots with explicit expectations and added pretty helper for test outputs.

changes.user_summary: Test output is now cleaner and uses source files for node utilities.
changes.dev_summary: Test suite now imports `@tailwindcss/node` from `src/` instead of `dist/` to avoid source map warnings.

changes.user_summary: Tests now use a generic `example-*` utility to avoid future conflicts.
changes.dev_summary: Test code updated to reference `example-*` utilities instead of `tab-*` for future-proofing.

changes.user_summary: Updated the `listhen` dependency to 1.10.0 with new features and fixes.
changes.dev_summary: Bumped `listhen` to 1.10.0, adding `extraURLs` support and IPv4 link-local filtering.

changes.user_summary: Adds `scrollbar-gutter-*` utilities to control scrollbar gutter behavior.
changes.dev_summary: Introduced `scrollbar-gutter-auto`, `scrollbar-gutter-stable`, and `scrollbar-gutter-both` classes mapping to `scrollbar-gutter` CSS.

changes.user_summary: Adds `zoom-*` utilities for scaling elements with percentage or arbitrary values.
changes.dev_summary: Introduced `zoom-50`, `zoom-[1.1]`, and `zoom-(--value)` classes mapping to `zoom` CSS, positioned after `transform` in property order.

changes.user_summary: Adds `tab-*` utilities to set the tab-size property.
changes.dev_summary: Introduced `tab-2` and `tab-[12px]` classes mapping to `tab-size` CSS, added to property order near text layout properties.

changes.user_summary: Released Tailwind CSS v4.3.0 with updated package files and integrations.
changes.dev_summary: Version bump to 4.3.0, updating numerous package.json files and integration tests.

response.intro: This release adds several new utility classes and directives, including support for arbitrary selector &:has conversion, enhanced @variant syntax, functional utility defaults, and new scrollbar, scrollbar-gutter, zoom, and tab-size utilities. It also includes numerous fixes to resolver behavior, canonicalization, TypeScript typings, and code generation, along with internal dependency updates and test improvements.

This release improves the reliability of plugins and imports, and adds a set of new utilities for styling scrollbars, scaling elements, and tab size. It also refines variant handling and fixes several edge‑case issues with arbitrary values and TypeScript imports.
